retrieval.note: retrieve() scans every fact in the store, scores it (topic + subject + place + recency + salience + confidence) and sorts the survivors; nothing is indexed, so the cost is linear in the store and the store is capped at memory.CAPACITY = 64

grounding.note: ground() walks every fact of the speaker's store looking for one that supports every field of the candidate; a rejection is the full scan, an acceptance is the same scan (it keeps the best supporting fact), so the two cost the same — the validator has no fast path for a lie

with_proposition.example: Careful — I saw room 0 of building 101 was fine when I was there.

rendering.note: the renderer is pure string formatting over the semantic act: no model, no network, no state (render.py), so its cost never depends on the world

transfer.note: the threat case additionally invalidates the recipient's beliefs and runs _decide_avoid_one immediately (cognition/runtime.py: a warning is acted on at once, not next minute); the difference between the two rows is that decision

chatter.note: an identical (speaker, listener, act, line) inside 10 game minutes is the signature of a stuck loop; the cooldowns (ASK_COOLDOWN_S 1800 s, REQUEST_COOLDOWN_S 3600 s) and cognition's told-set are what should keep it at zero. The drain is once per game minute, so the 5000-row event ring never loses a row

profile.note: only DialogueRuntime.advance and the player TALK path are profiled (cProfile.runcall around each), so the shares below are shares of dialogue, not of the whole world step. cProfile inflates absolute cost; read the shares.

hotspots.scaling: per 1 s substep (60 per game minute): a sorted walk of EVERY conversation kept — active or not, up to MAX_CONVERSATIONS_KEPT = 400 — plus a walk of every request ever made (dialogue/runtime.py:640-680); the sort of the keys is redone every second
per speech act: one ground() over the speaker's store, one render(), two event rows
per active conversation per second: availability of both, co-presence when face to face, the fresh-threat interrupt check, then one queued act
per told fact: say() plus cognition.receive_fact plus two event rows
per conversation per second: a full scan of one citizen's store (up to 64 facts) for a fresh first-hand threat
per asserted proposition: a full scan of the speaker's store for a supporting fact
per query: a full scan of the store (<= memory.CAPACITY = 64 facts), a score per fact and a sort of the survivors
per speech act: pure string formatting
per told fact: the told copy, belief invalidation, three cognition events and — for a threat — the avoidance decision immediately

day.note: the same bundle, seed and hours, booted once with START_WORLD dialogue:true and once with dialogue:false; each game minute is timed on its own and split by instance wrappers on every runtime's advance. The cognition delta is what routing warnings and help requests through conversations costs the cognition runtime itself

chatter_day.note: an identical (speaker, listener, act, line) inside 10 game minutes is the signature of a stuck loop; the cooldowns (ASK_COOLDOWN_S 1800 s, REQUEST_COOLDOWN_S 3600 s) and cognition's told-set are what should keep it at zero. The drain is once per game minute, so the 5000-row event ring never loses a row

budget.note: at 24x one game minute is 2.5 s of real time (2500 ms). The heaviest measured mean game-minute (137.9 ms) uses 5.52% of it; the dialogue runtime is 0.278 ms of the day mean (0.2% of the whole world step). The worst single measured game minute is 10840.987 ms at 16.0h, of which dialogue is 0.624 ms — the spike is the rest of the world, not the conversations, and one player TALK answers in 0.1947 ms — a keystroke, not a frame.
